connector.name: Duplicati MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Duplicati backup management - list, run, monitor and configure jobs from an LLM.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image duplicati-mcp:v1.1.1. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the kcofoni account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DUPLICATI_URL
env.description: URL of the Duplicati instance (e.g. http://localhost:8200)

env.name: DUPLICATI_PASSWORD
env.description: Duplicati web interface password (leave empty if none configured)

env.name: DUPLICATI_READONLY
env.description: Set to true to disable write operations (run, abort, update, import). Default: false

env.name: DUPLICATI_DB_PATH
env.description: Path to Duplicati-server.sqlite — enables SQLite history tools (db_*). Leave empty to disable.
